strapiBlog.title: Top 5 Villa and Townhouse Communities in Dubai

data.text:
Villa and townhouse communities in Dubai present a perfect opportunity to own a perfect family home. They come with picture-perfect properties, lush golf courses or stunning beach fronts, landscaped gardens, and many other facilities. Residential units in these communities offer enhanced privacy and an ultra-exclusive lifestyle. They come with bigger, spacious rooms, private swimming pools, and an array of other facilities.

If you’re looking for townhouses and villas for sale in Dubai, the biggest challenge you will face is the selection of the locality that’s a perfect fit for you. To help you with this, we have jotted down a list of the top 5 villa and townhouse communities in Dubai. Take a look at them:

5 Best Communities in Dubai for Villas and Townhouses

1. Arabian Ranches

Also known as ‘the Ranches’, Arabian Ranches happens to be among the first freehold neighbourhoods in the emirate. The launch of this community enabled expats to own a luxurious property in Dubai they could call their home and have full rights over.

Being one of the most popular communities in Dubai, it truly reflects the suburban lifestyle. The neighbourhood houses Arabian Ranches Golf Club and several other notable landmarks, such as Dubai Polo Equestrian and Club. It is developed by Emaar and boasts some of the most beautiful standalone dwellings found in the entire emirate. These units are available in different configurations and feature architecture inspired by Arabian and Mediterranean designs.

The total area covered by this community spans over 1,650 acres. It is a family-friendly, self-contained gated neighbourhood located alongside Sheikh Zayed Road. As The Ranches is a well-connected neighbourhood, commuting is very easy for residents.

2. Emirates Living

Emirates Living is a master development, occupying a prime location near Jebel Ali Racecourse. It is a freehold, large-scale villa community by Emaar Property, designed to offer an upscale lifestyle with every amenity and facility available for its residents.

The community covers an area of over 52.2 million square feet and houses more than 8,000 properties, including luxury villas, townhouses and apartments. This development is divided into five different communities:

  • Meadows Dubai
  • The Springs
  • Emirates Hills
  • The Lakes
  • Hattan

There’s also a highly popular Montgomerie Golf course nestled in Emirates Living along with more than 20 parks and lakes. The infrastructure is well-planned, housing units are modern, and there’s everything one looks to lead a lavish lifestyle. It’s rightly termed as the “Beverly Hills of Dubai”. You can find customised mansions, cosy apartments and other types of properties, depending on your requirements and budget.

3. Dubai Hills Estate

One of the most sought-after communities in Dubai, Dubai Hills Estate sits conveniently along the Al Khail Road, providing residents with convenient access to major parts of the emirate.  Al Barsha South, Downtown Dubai are two popular areas that lie close to this neighbourhood. It is a joint venture between Meraas Holding and Emaar Properties and nestles various sub-communities where you can buy luxury villas and townhouses, apart from apartments and residential plots.

More than 1.4 million square metres of the total area is dedicated to open spaces and parks. The lush greenery adds an element of tranquillity and freshness to this area.

Dubai Hills Estate houses an 18-hole championship golf course, a bicycle route covering an area of 54 km and the locality’s own mega mall. It spreads over 2700 acres and has earned a reputation for being a family-friendly community with modern living spaces having state-of-the-art facilities and amenities. Due to all these features, it is also ranked among the best areas to look for villas for rent in Dubai.

data.text:
4. Jumeirah Golf Estates (JGE)

Famous for offering a high-end and upscale lifestyle, Jumeirah Golf Estate is a vibrant community offering a mix of residential properties in varying configurations and layouts. It has lush green spaces covering 1,100 hectares, five beautiful lakes and a sustainable environment.

This area enjoys the privilege of hosting the DP World Tour Championship as it features two world-class golf courses, “Fire and Earth”. Residential properties overlook these golf courses and offer residents unobstructed views of lush green gardens. In total, there are 16 communities set around these golf courses. The Fire Course comprising seven communities is inspired by the ‘desert theme’. It has 438 residential units. The Earth Courses, on the other hand, has 6 developments containing 606 units, designed as per the Mediterranean architecture. Townhouses and apartments are available in An Andalus enclave within JGE.

Although JGE has different types of residential properties, it’s the villas and townhouses that have contributed to its popularity. These dwellings are masterfully planned, eloquently designed and come laced with unparalleled amenities, offering a premium way of living.

JGE’s prime location is another major factor that makes it a suitable choice if you are looking for a villa or townhouse for sale in Dubai. It is situated along Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and neighbours popular communities, such as JVC and Sports City and IMPZ. The Dubai Metro Extension route has made it even more accessible.

5. Dubailand

Concluding the list of best communities for villas and townhouses in the emirate, Dubailand is not just a residential development but also a popular tourist spot. It is divided into numerous districts, including:

  • Majan
  • Tiger Woods
  • Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club
  • Rukan
  • Villanova
  • FalconCity of Wonders
  • Laval
  • Dubailand Oasis
  • Living Legends
  • Al Waha

Covering a massive area of 3 billion square feet, Dubailand can be termed as a city within a city. It nestles in itself several leisure destinations and attractions, including themed adventure parks. This project by Dubai Properties features a mix of residential properties. Villas are available in 2 to 6 bedroom configurations, while townhouses can be found in 1 to 4 bedroom layouts. These properties are beautifully designed and come with the latest amenities and facilities.

Due to their modern architecture, spacious rooms and well-planned layouts, villas and townhouses in Dubailand are preferred by both locals and expats.
